style_reference_role: Existing character art used only as a picture-book style reference
prompt: Create a new reusable background plate for the children's educational series Num-Num Numbers, for an episode about counting in hexadecimal hosted by an existing striped cat. Use the supplied image ONLY as the style reference for soft hand-painted gouache, warm brown outlines, subtle paper grain, rounded picture-book shapes, and gentle children's illustration. Asset theme Starry Observatory. A welcoming fictional hilltop observatory terrace after sunset: deep clear sapphire and periwinkle sky with a softly glowing small crescent moon and a handful of calm stars, rounded distant blue hills, a pale sandstone circular terrace with low copper details at its outer edges, and a small cream-and-copper observatory dome visible near the far left skyline. A simple brass telescope on a tripod can be visible at far left, pointing toward the upper sky. Keep these distinctive observatory details along the far left and top edges where they will remain visible around the teaching overlays. Main composition must reserve the left quarter from 24% down for the existing cat character and an exceptionally broad low-detail open stage across center and right for the separate cream lesson board. Soft moonlight, warm dome light, muted lavender and dusty blue stones, small soft plants at outer corners. Eye-level wide establishing shot, full-bleed 16:9 landscape. Keep foreground quiet and bright enough for the golden-yellow cat to sit naturally. Background plate only, no cat, no people or animals, no panels, signs, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermark, fake star chart, or readable text. Original imagined scene.
